tables.name: Hardship Likelihood
tables.description: Modified by Age. Each result's value is one more than its number of hardships (values must be positive): Hardship Type and Hardship Outcome are rolled value - 1 times.

results.name: No Hardship
results.description: The village has been lucky, and nothing has troubled it so far.

results.name: One Hardship
results.description: The village has experienced one notable time of difficulty.

results.name: Two Hardships
results.description: The village has gone through a couple of hardships.

results.name: Three Hardships
results.description: The village has experienced three difficult situations.

results.name: Four Hardships
results.description: The village has been beset by four trying times.
